282:t_1:87.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's enough, $$チェインバー#pilot$$. Consider this an educational warning.」

282:t_1:88.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Question. What is an educational warning?」

282:t_1:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I-it's originally a judo term for a warning before a formal penalty, but here it concerns conduct judged to violate ethical standards for minors...」

282:t_1:91.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Stop trying to hold back your laughter, $n!」

282:t_1:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「A-anyway! Now that we've had a chance to settle down, let's review what's happened!」

282:t_1:93.en:
$$チコ$$
「What bothers me most is that woman we met in that strange space.」

282:t_1:94.en:
$$ボス$$
「Don't worry. She's on our side.」

282:t_1:95.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What makes you say that? Her being beautiful isn't any reason to trust her.」

282:t_1:98.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「But I agree with $$ボス$$ too.」

282:t_1:100.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Leaving her looks aside, I just can't believe she's our enemy.」

282:t_1:101.en:
$$甲児$$
「I agree with you on that.」

282:t_1:103.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノ$$ felt that way too.」

282:t_1:105.en:
$n
「...I certainly don't think my $$血塗られた眼$$ is unrelated to that woman...」

282:t_1:106.en:
$n
「But I... Like everyone else, I didn't sense any hostility from her.」

282:t_1:107.en:
$$チコ$$
「So our instincts say she's innocent... I can't argue with that either.」

282:t_1:108.en:
$$甲児$$
「The biggest thing we learned on this trip was how the universe collapses.」

282:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「The force that seeks to vanish clashes with the force that seeks to exist...」

282:t_1:110.en:
$n
「And the force that seeks to vanish creates $$バアル$$ to extinguish the power of life...」

282:t_1:111.en:
$$甲児$$
「When I first heard about the universe collapsing, I had no idea how we could stop something like that, but...」

282:t_1:112.en:
$$甲児$$
「Basically, we just can't lose to $$バアル$$, right? Knowing what to do makes it easier to handle.」

282:t_1:113.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes... My world defeated $$バアル$$... the $$宇宙怪獣$$. I think that's how we survived.」

282:t_1:114.en:
$$ボス$$
「But... From what we heard, this collapse happens every 120 million years, on top of the one every 12,000 years, right?」

282:t_1:115.en:
$$さやか$$
「It'll produce even more $$バアル$$ than the collapse every 12,000 years, won't it...?」

282:t_1:116.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It might. Only $$宇宙怪獣$$ appeared in my world, but...」

282:t_1:117.en:
$$ラルク$$
「This world has both the $$宇宙怪獣$$ $$ノリコ$$ fought and the type we fought.」

282:t_1:118.en:
$$レド$$
「Plus $$インベーダー#robot$$s, $$バジュラ$$, and $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

282:t_1:119.en:
$$ランカ$$
「Wait, $$レド$$... The $$バジュラ$$ aren't $$バアル$$.」

282:t_1:120.en:
$$シェリル$$
「We can communicate with the $$バジュラ$$ through something other than words.」

282:t_1:121.en:
$$レド$$
「But we've actually fought the $$バジュラ$$. This isn't a question of communication.」

282:t_1:122.en:
$$アルト$$
「We just haven't established how to do it yet. Once we do...」

282:t_1:123.en:
$$レド$$
「You're naive. Fighting in the galaxy should have taught you that there's no time to consider the enemy's circumstances.」

282:t_1:124.en:
$$アルト$$
「Wait, $$レド$$. Are you saying we have to fight anyone we can't communicate with?」

282:t_1:125.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then if a little misunderstanding had started a fight when we met on the $$翠の地球$$, would we have had to kill each other?」

282:t_1:127.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Stop it, both of you.」

282:t_1:128.en:
$$シェリル$$
「$$エイミー$$'s right. We can communicate with each other, so talk it out instead of picking a fight.」

282:t_1:130.en:
$$レド$$
「No... We were both at fault.」

282:t_1:131.en:
$$レド$$
「But when we met the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ again at the galactic center, I remembered the Alliance's battles... All my comrades... Hundreds they killed...」

282:t_1:133.en:
$$レド$$
「I... If the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ attack, I won't hesitate to fight.」

282:t_1:134.en:
$n
「Neither will I. If the enemy attacks, I'll meet them with everything I've got.」

282:t_1:135.en:
$$甲児$$
「Still, if talking can stop the fighting, that's the best outcome.」

282:t_1:137.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Speaking of which, $$レド$$... Wasn't the galactic center in the territory of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ you came from?」

282:t_1:138.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Does that mean you could have gone home?」

282:t_1:139.en:
$$レド$$
「...So much kept happening that I had no time to think about it.」

282:t_1:140.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「What would you do if we went to the galactic center again?」

282:t_1:144.en:
$$ボス$$
「Is that an enemy attack alarm...!?」

282:t_1:145.en:
$$さやか$$
「If there's an enemy out here, it must be...」

282:t_1:147.en:
$$チコ$$
「Huh...? Come to think of it, where's $$ニコラ$$?」

282:t_1:148.en:
$$ラルク$$
「He's using the facilities here to send data on the $$宇宙怪獣$$ we encountered in the galaxy.」

282:t_1:150.en:
$$ラルク$$
「To the Space Force, I suppose?」

282:t_1:151.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's enough chatting. If it's $$バアル$$, we absolutely can't lose.」

282:t_1:152.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We're back inside the solar system now... Close to Earth.」

282:t_2:5.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then let's begin our briefing on our next course of action.」

282:t_2:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, $$ティエリア$$... Please report on the unknowns we fought today.」

282:t_2:7.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I believe you've all experienced their threat firsthand, but I'd like to review the facts currently known to us.」

282:t_2:9.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「First, for convenience, we will refer to those unknowns as 《$$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$》 from now on.」

282:t_2:11.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It stands for Extraterrestrial Living-metal Shape-shifter.」

282:t_2:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「So they're weird metal creatures from outer space.」

282:t_2:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We don't know where the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ came from, or why they entered this solar system.」

282:t_2:14.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The key facts are that communication with them is essentially impossible, and they possess extremely dangerous abilities.」
